phrases.text: I am writing to inquire about the position.
phrases.explanation: Formal: usa 'I am writing to' + infinitivo para el propósito.

phrases.text: Please find attached the requested document.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'please find attached' es fórmula estándar de adjuntos.

phrases.text: I would be grateful if you could reply at your earliest convenience.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'I would be grateful if' + condicional = cortesía alta.

phrases.text: I look forward to hearing from you.
phrases.explanation: Formal: cierre estándar de emails profesionales.

phrases.text: With regard to your recent inquiry, please see our response below.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'with regard to' introduce el tema de forma profesional.

phrases.text: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you require further assistance.
phrases.explanation: Formal: ofrece ayuda adicional de manera cortés y profesional.

phrases.text: I trust this email finds you well.
phrases.explanation: Formal: saludo inicial clásico en correspondencia profesional.

phrases.text: I am writing on behalf of our company to address your concern.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'on behalf of' indica representación institucional.

phrases.text: Kindly confirm receipt of this message.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'kindly' es más formal que 'please' en algunos contextos.

phrases.text: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
phrases.explanation: Formal: disculpa corporativa con 'we' y vocabulario elevado.

phrases.text: As per our telephone conversation earlier today, I am sending the files.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'as per' referencia conversaciones previas de forma profesional.

phrases.text: Should you have any questions, please feel free to reach out.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'should you' = condicional formal, más elegante que 'if you'.

phrases.text: I hereby confirm the details of our agreement.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'hereby' indica acción oficial o legal en el mensaje.

phrases.text: Dear Mr. Johnson, I hope this message reaches you in good health.
phrases.explanation: Formal: saludo con título + apellido y deseo de salud.

phrases.text: Your prompt attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pide urgencia de manera indirecta y respetuosa.

phrases.text: Hey! Just wanted to check in – how are things?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'hey' y 'check in' son expresiones coloquiales.

phrases.text: Can you send me the file ASAP? Thanks!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'ASAP' (as soon as possible) es abreviatura coloquial.

phrases.text: Sounds good to me! Let's go with that.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'sounds good' y 'let's go with that' son expresiones casuales.

phrases.text: Sorry for the late reply, been super busy!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'super busy' y la estructura corta sin sujeto son coloquiales.

phrases.text: BTW, did you see the news about the project?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'BTW' (by the way) es una abreviatura informal muy común.

phrases.text: I'll get back to you later, gotta run!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'gotta' (got to) y 'gotta run' son muy coloquiales.

phrases.text: What's the deal with the meeting tomorrow?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'what's the deal with' es una expresión coloquial americana.

phrases.text: No worries, take your time!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'no worries' es una respuesta casual, no se usa en contextos formales.

phrases.text: Hope you're doing well! Miss chatting with you.
phrases.explanation: Informal: tono personal y emotivo, no apropiado para contextos profesionales.

phrases.text: Yo! Quick question – are you free this week?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'yo' como saludo y 'quick question' son expresiones muy coloquiales.

phrases.text: Lol, I totally forgot to attach it. Here it is!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'lol' y 'I totally forgot' son expresiones de lenguaje casual digital.

phrases.text: Let me know what you think, okay?
phrases.explanation: Informal: cerrar con 'okay?' o 'ok?' es casual, no formal.

phrases.text: Heads up – the deadline moved to Friday.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'heads up' es una advertencia coloquial, equivale a 'aviso'.

phrases.text: Thanks a bunch! Really helped me out.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'thanks a bunch' es agradecimiento exagerado e informal.

phrases.text: Ping me when you're done, yeah?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'ping me' y 'yeah?' son propios del lenguaje digital casual.

phrases.text: Hi! How are you?
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'Hi' es el saludo más básico entre amigos, muy usado en Unit 1.

phrases.text: Hello! Nice to meet you.
phrases.explanation: Informal/neutral: 'Hello' y 'nice to meet you' son frases de presentación básicas.

phrases.text: See you soon!
phrases.explanation: Informal: despedida corta y amistosa, apropiada para nivel principiante.

phrases.text: Bye! Take care!
phrases.explanation: Informal: cierre muy casual, típico de mensajes entre amigos.

phrases.text: Talk soon!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'talk soon' es un cierre digital amigable y muy usado.

phrases.text: Sorry for the late reply!
phrases.explanation: Informal: disculpa casual sin estructura formal.

phrases.text: Thank you for your email.
phrases.explanation: Formal/neutral: agradecimiento estándar al inicio de una respuesta.

phrases.text: Hope you are well!
phrases.explanation: Informal/neutral: saludo de apertura básico, apropiado para principiantes.

phrases.text: Write back soon!
phrases.explanation: Informal: invita a responder, tono amigable y sencillo.

phrases.text: Best wishes.
phrases.explanation: Formal/neutral: cierre educado, más formal que 'bye' pero aprendido en nivel básico.

phrases.text: How is your family?
phrases.explanation: Informal: pregunta sobre la familia, apropiada entre amigos o conocidos.

phrases.text: My family is fine, thanks for asking!
phrases.explanation: Informal: respuesta amigable sobre la familia.

phrases.text: Give my regards to your family.
phrases.explanation: Informal/formal: expresión educada para mandar saludos a la familia.

phrases.text: I am writing because I have some news!
phrases.explanation: Informal: apertura casual para compartir novedades, sin el formalismo de 'I am writing to inquire'.

phrases.text: I am writing to introduce myself.
phrases.explanation: Formal/neutral: presentación formal al inicio de un email de contacto.

phrases.text: I hope everything is going well for you!
phrases.explanation: Informal: saludo empático y amigable, muy frecuente en emails informales.

phrases.text: It was so good to hear from you!
phrases.explanation: Informal: expresión de alegría al recibir un mensaje, tono personal.

phrases.text: We miss you! Come visit us soon.
phrases.explanation: Informal: expresión afectuosa, completamente inapropiada en contexto formal.

phrases.text: My name is Carlos and I am from Argentina.
phrases.explanation: Formal/neutral: presentación directa y clara, apropiada en cualquier contexto.

phrases.text: Can't wait to see you!
phrases.explanation: Informal: contracción + expresión de entusiasmo, tono muy casual.

phrases.text: What are you doing these days?
phrases.explanation: Informal: pregunta casual sobre actividades cotidianas.

phrases.text: I'm very busy at work lately!
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual usando contracción 'I'm', tono amigable.

phrases.text: Let's meet for coffee soon!
phrases.explanation: Informal: propuesta informal de encuentro, completamente fuera de lugar en emails formales.

phrases.text: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly.
phrases.explanation: Informal/neutral: agradecimiento simple y directo, menos formal que 'I appreciate your prompt response'.

phrases.text: See you on Monday!
phrases.explanation: Informal: cierre con referencia al día de la semana, tono muy casual.

phrases.text: I'll be free next week if you want to chat.
phrases.explanation: Informal: propuesta casual usando contracción 'I'll', lenguaje simple.

phrases.text: I usually check emails in the morning.
phrases.explanation: Informal/neutral: información práctica sobre rutina, tono conversacional.

phrases.text: I am available on Monday or Tuesday if you would like to meet.
phrases.explanation: Formal: ofrece disponibilidad de manera educada, apropiado para concertar reuniones.

phrases.text: Drop me a message when you get a chance!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'drop me a message' es coloquial, equivale a 'mandame un mensaje'.

phrases.text: I just wanted to say hello and check in!
phrases.explanation: Informal: apertura amigable sin propósito formal, típica de emails entre amigos.

phrases.text: I would like to request information about your services.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'I would like to' es más cortés y formal que 'I want to'.

phrases.text: Could you please provide further details about the opening times?
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'could you please' es una petición muy educada, usada en contextos de hotel o museo.

phrases.text: I am interested in visiting your museum next week.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura directa y clara sobre el propósito de la visita.

phrases.text: Do you know if the museum is open on Sunday?
phrases.explanation: Informal/neutral: pregunta directa sin fórmulas formales, tono coloquial.

phrases.text: We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'we look forward to' es cierre profesional muy usado en hotelería.

phrases.text: Please confirm your reservation by Friday.
phrases.explanation: Formal: instrucción directa y educada con fecha límite.

phrases.text: Is there free Wi-Fi at the hotel? Just checking!
phrases.explanation: Informal: pregunta casual con 'just checking', tono muy coloquial.

phrases.text: Could you send me the report by end of business today?
phrases.explanation: Formal: petición con 'could you' y plazo específico, tono profesional.

phrases.text: I am attaching the document for your review.
phrases.explanation: Formal: fórmula estándar para adjuntar archivos en emails de trabajo.

phrases.text: Please let me know if you need anything else.
phrases.explanation: Formal: ofrecimiento de ayuda adicional, cierre profesional muy común.

phrases.text: Hey, can you resend that file? I think it got lost.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'hey' + pregunta directa sin formalidades, tono digital casual.

phrases.text: I am writing to report a technical issue with the system.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura para reportar un problema de forma profesional.

phrases.text: My computer crashed again. Can you help?
phrases.explanation: Informal: mensaje casual de ayuda, sin estructura formal.

phrases.text: We will resolve this issue as soon as possible.
phrases.explanation: Formal: respuesta corporativa de compromiso, usa 'we' institucional.

phrases.text: I am very satisfied with the service I received.
phrases.explanation: Formal: elogio educado y formal, apropiado en respuesta a encuestas o en cartas.

phrases.text: Unfortunately, the product was not as described on your website.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'unfortunately' introduce una queja de manera cortés y profesional.

phrases.text: I would appreciate a quick response to this matter.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pide urgencia con 'I would appreciate', tono respetuoso.

phrases.text: I would like to request a full refund for this purchase.
phrases.explanation: Formal: petición de reembolso con 'I would like to', el estándar en quejas formales.

phrases.text: The food was amazing! We'll definitely come back.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario entusiasta con contracción 'we'll', tono muy casual.

phrases.text: Honestly, the service was a bit slow today.
phrases.explanation: Informal: queja directa y casual usando 'honestly', sin el protocolo formal.

phrases.text: My name is Carlos and I am from Argentina.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: estructura básica 'My name is' + 'I am from' para presentarse en Unit 1.

phrases.text: I am twenty years old.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: forma correcta de decir la edad en inglés, sin 'years' suelto.

phrases.text: I live in Buenos Aires.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: 'I live in' + ciudad, una de las frases más básicas de presentación.

phrases.text: It is nice to meet you!
phrases.explanation: Presentación: saludo básico al conocer a alguien. 'Nice to meet you' es la versión corta.

phrases.text: I am a student at university.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: 'I am a + profesión/rol' para decir qué hacés. No usa 'the' antes de university.

phrases.text: I am learning English because I want to travel.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: explica motivación con 'because I want to + infinitivo', estructura A1.

phrases.text: My favourite colour is blue.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: 'My favourite + noun + is' para describir preferencias básicas.

phrases.text: I have got a cat and a dog.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: 'have got' para describir posesiones o mascotas en presentaciones.

phrases.text: I am from a small city in the north.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: alternativa a decir el nombre de la ciudad, describe la ubicación.

phrases.text: I speak Spanish and a little English.
phrases.explanation: Presentación: 'I speak + idioma' para mencionar idiomas. 'a little' indica nivel básico.

phrases.text: I have a small family.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: 'I have a + adjetivo + family' para describir el tamaño de la familia.

phrases.text: I have one brother and two sisters.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: menciona hermanos con 'I have + número + brother/sister'.

phrases.text: My mother is a teacher. She works in a school.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: describe la profesión de un familiar con 'is a + profession'.

phrases.text: My father is forty-five years old.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: aplica la estructura de edad a un familiar.

phrases.text: I am married and I have two children.
phrases.explanation: Presentación personal: 'I am married/single' + 'I have + children' para estado civil.

phrases.text: I live with my parents and my younger brother.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: 'I live with' + 'my + family member' para hablar de convivencia.

phrases.text: My sister is very funny and friendly.
phrases.explanation: Descripción familiar: adjetivos de personalidad con 'My + member + is + adjective'.

phrases.text: My family is very important to me.
phrases.explanation: Presentación familiar: expresa afecto con 'important to me', frase sencilla y personal.

phrases.text: We have a house near the park.
phrases.explanation: Presentación del hogar: 'we have a + tipo de vivienda + near/in + lugar'.

phrases.text: My grandmother lives in a small village.
phrases.explanation: Descripción familiar: ubica a un familiar con 'lives in + lugar'.

phrases.text: In my free time, I love listening to music.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'In my free time, I love + verb-ing' es la estructura estándar para hablar de pasatiempos.

phrases.text: I enjoy reading books and watching films.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'I enjoy + verb-ing' lista actividades. Se pueden unir con 'and'.

phrases.text: I play football with my friends at the weekend.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'I play + sport + with + who + when' estructura completa para actividades deportivas.

phrases.text: I do not like cooking very much.
phrases.explanation: Preferencias: 'I do not like + verb-ing' para expresar lo que no te gusta.

phrases.text: My favourite hobby is drawing.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'My favourite hobby is + verb-ing' o sustantivo, estructura de presentación.

phrases.text: I also like going to the cinema.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'I also like' agrega otra actividad, 'also' evita repetir 'and I like'.

phrases.text: At the weekend, I usually go swimming.
phrases.explanation: Rutina/hobbies: 'at the weekend + adverb + go + verb-ing' para actividades de fin de semana.

phrases.text: I am interested in photography and travel.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'I am interested in + noun/verb-ing' es alternativa más formal a 'I like'.

phrases.text: I sometimes go hiking in the mountains.
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'sometimes' como adverbio de frecuencia antes del verbo principal.

phrases.text: Cooking is not my thing, but I love baking!
phrases.explanation: Hobbies: 'not my thing' es expresión coloquial para decir que algo no te gusta.

phrases.text: I am writing to confirm my hotel reservation for the dates below.
phrases.explanation: Formal: fórmula estándar para confirmar reservas por email.

phrases.text: Could you please provide information about airport transfer options?
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'could you please' + pregunta indirecta, cortesía típica de turismo.

phrases.text: I would like to request a refund for my cancelled flight.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'I would like to request' es más formal que 'I want'.

phrases.text: Hey, I've booked the flights! Can't wait for the trip.
phrases.explanation: Informal: present perfect casual + contracción 'can't wait', tono entusiasta.

phrases.text: Just landed! The hotel is way nicer than I expected.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comparativo casual con 'way nicer than', típico de mensajes de viaje.

phrases.text: Do you know if we need a visa for this trip?
phrases.explanation: Informal: pregunta directa sin fórmulas, tono conversacional entre amigos.

phrases.text: I am writing to formally apply for the position advertised on your website.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura estándar para una carta de postulación laboral.

phrases.text: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your consideration.
phrases.explanation: Formal: fórmula fija para adjuntar documentos en postulaciones.

phrases.text: I was informed that the position is still available.
phrases.explanation: Formal: voz pasiva + estilo indirecto, tono profesional y objetivo.

phrases.text: Guess what, I got the job! So excited!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'guess what' como apertura casual para dar una noticia.

phrases.text: My boss told me I did a great job today.
phrases.explanation: Informal: estilo indirecto simple con 'told me', tono cotidiano.

phrases.text: Work has been crazy busy lately, ugh.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'ugh' y 'crazy busy' son coloquialismos de queja informal.

phrases.text: I am writing to request a medical appointment at your earliest convenience.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'at your earliest convenience' pide urgencia cortésmente.

phrases.text: Should my symptoms persist, I will seek further medical advice.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'should + sujeto' es una forma elegante del primer condicional.

phrases.text: I would appreciate it if you could confirm my appointment time.
phrases.explanation: Formal: petición cortés estándar para confirmar horarios.

phrases.text: I might have caught a cold, feeling pretty rough.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'might have' expresa posibilidad de forma casual.

phrases.text: I used to get sick a lot as a kid, but I'm better now.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'used to' para hábito pasado, tono conversacional.

phrases.text: If I don't feel better tomorrow, I'll go to the doctor.
phrases.explanation: Informal: primer condicional en tono cotidiano y directo.

phrases.text: We are writing to raise awareness about the environmental impact of this project.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura institucional típica de ONGs o comunicados.

phrases.text: Measures that protect local wildlife should be prioritized.
phrases.explanation: Formal: cláusula de relativo 'that' en tono de propuesta profesional.

phrases.text: If more resources were allocated, recycling programs would improve significantly.
phrases.explanation: Formal: segundo condicional en contexto de propuesta o informe.

phrases.text: If I had more time, I'd volunteer for a beach clean-up.
phrases.explanation: Informal: segundo condicional casual con contracción 'I'd'.

phrases.text: Have you seen the documentary that's about ocean plastic?
phrases.explanation: Informal: cláusula de relativo simple en pregunta cotidiana.

phrases.text: We should really recycle more, don't you think?
phrases.explanation: Informal: sugerencia casual con question tag ('don't you think?').

phrases.text: I am writing in response to the article published in your magazine.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura estándar para cartas al editor o quejas de medios.

phrases.text: It was reported that the event attracted a record audience.
phrases.explanation: Formal: voz pasiva para reportar información de manera objetiva.

phrases.text: I have been following your coverage of this topic with great interest.
phrases.explanation: Formal: present perfect continuous para expresar interés sostenido.

phrases.text: Have you been watching that new show everyone's talking about?
phrases.explanation: Informal: present perfect continuous en pregunta casual entre amigos.

phrases.text: She said the ending was totally unexpected!
phrases.explanation: Informal: estilo indirecto simple, tono entusiasta.

phrases.text: I've been binge-watching series all weekend, lol.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'binge-watching' y 'lol' son coloquialismos digitales.

phrases.text: I am writing to outline our plans for the upcoming quarter.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura profesional para presentar planes o proyectos.

phrases.text: Unless we receive further instructions, we will proceed as scheduled.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'unless' en tono profesional y directo.

phrases.text: We look forward to discussing these plans in more detail.
phrases.explanation: Formal: gerundio tras 'look forward to', cierre profesional común.

phrases.text: I'm going to travel next month, so excited!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'going to' para planes ya decididos, tono casual.

phrases.text: I'll let you know once I've decided, unless you hear from me first!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'will' espontáneo + 'unless' en tono conversacional.

phrases.text: I keep thinking about quitting my job, haha.
phrases.explanation: Informal: gerundio tras 'keep', tono relajado con 'haha'.

phrases.text: I am writing to express my concerns regarding recent social policy changes.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura típica de cartas de opinión o reclamos institucionales.

phrases.text: Had the proposal been implemented sooner, the results might have been different.
phrases.explanation: Formal: tercer condicional invertido (had + participio), registro elevado.

phrases.text: We would appreciate your consideration of these matters at your earliest convenience.
phrases.explanation: Formal: cierre cortés típico de comunicaciones institucionales.

phrases.text: Honestly, I wish things had turned out differently.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'wish + past perfect' para lamentar el pasado, tono personal.

phrases.text: If we'd known earlier, we would've done something about it.
phrases.explanation: Informal: tercer condicional contraído ('we'd', 'would've'), habla natural.

phrases.text: It's crazy how much things have changed, don't you think?
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual con question tag.

phrases.text: I am writing to share some observations about our new software, which was launched last month.
phrases.explanation: Formal: cláusula no restrictiva con 'which', típica de reportes.

phrases.text: What concerns us most is the system's vulnerability to outages.
phrases.explanation: Formal: oración hendida 'what + verbo' para enfatizar un punto en un informe.

phrases.text: Rarely do we encounter issues of this magnitude.
phrases.explanation: Formal: inversión en tono profesional para dar énfasis.

phrases.text: My phone, which I just got, already has a cracked screen lol.
phrases.explanation: Informal: cláusula no restrictiva en tono casual con 'lol'.

phrases.text: What really bugs me is how slow the app has gotten.
phrases.explanation: Informal: oración hendida coloquial con 'bugs me'.

phrases.text: Never have I seen an update break so many things!
phrases.explanation: Informal: inversión usada de forma exagerada/humorística entre amigos.

phrases.text: I am writing to inquire whether the exhibition has been extended.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pregunta indirecta cortés en contexto cultural/museos.

phrases.text: The artifacts must have been preserved using traditional methods.
phrases.explanation: Formal: modal perfect 'must have been' para especular con certeza.

phrases.text: Furthermore, the collection was curated by a team of local historians.
phrases.explanation: Formal: conector 'furthermore' + voz pasiva, registro académico/cultural.

phrases.text: That must've been such an amazing trip, I'm so jealous!
phrases.explanation: Informal: modal perfect contraído, tono entusiasta.

phrases.text: Honestly, the museum could've been organized a bit better.
phrases.explanation: Informal: modal perfect de crítica suave, tono conversacional.

phrases.text: Anyway, thanks for sharing those photos from the festival!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'anyway' como conector casual para cambiar de tema.

phrases.text: Although the results were mixed, we remain optimistic about future growth.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'although' + cláusula concesiva en contexto de negocios.

phrases.text: Should funding become available, expansion would be considered.
phrases.explanation: Formal: estructura hipotética invertida ('should'), tono corporativo.

phrases.text: The implementation of this strategy requires careful evaluation.
phrases.explanation: Formal: nominalización ('implementation', 'evaluation'), típico de informes de negocios.

phrases.text: Even though sales dropped, I think we're still doing okay.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'even though' en tono conversacional entre colegas.

phrases.text: If I were in charge, I'd change the whole marketing plan.
phrases.explanation: Informal: estructura hipotética casual con contracción.

phrases.text: Honestly, this quarter's been rough, but we'll bounce back.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual sobre negocios, tono relajado.

phrases.text: It is widely recognized that international cooperation is crucial to this issue.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pasiva impersonal para dar autoridad al enunciado.

phrases.text: Only through collective action can meaningful change be achieved.
phrases.explanation: Formal: fronting con inversión, típico de discursos formales.

phrases.text: We would like to formally propose a joint initiative between our organizations.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'we would like to formally propose', registro diplomático.

phrases.text: Everyone says we need to work together more, and honestly, I agree.
phrases.explanation: Informal: pasiva simplificada 'everyone says', tono casual.

phrases.text: Only then did I really understand how connected everything is.
phrases.explanation: Informal: inversión usada en tono personal/reflexivo.

phrases.text: It's wild how global everything has become, right?
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual, question tag 'right?'.

phrases.text: I am writing to submit our research findings for your review.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura estándar para envíos académicos.

phrases.text: By the end of the year, the team will have completed the full study.
phrases.explanation: Formal: future perfect en contexto de cronograma de investigación.

phrases.text: The researcher stated that further trials would be necessary.
phrases.explanation: Formal: estilo indirecto formal ('stated that'), registro académico.

phrases.text: By next week, I'll have finished writing my thesis, finally!
phrases.explanation: Informal: future perfect con tono de alivio.

phrases.text: She told me the results were way better than expected!
phrases.explanation: Informal: estilo indirecto simple, tono entusiasta.

phrases.text: Honestly, I can't wait to be done with this experiment.
phrases.explanation: Informal: expresión de cansancio/entusiasmo, tono conversacional.

phrases.text: It is imperative that the committee review this proposal without delay.
phrases.explanation: Formal: subjuntivo formal ('it is imperative that' + verbo base), típico de política/gobierno.

phrases.text: Never has public opinion been so divided on a single issue.
phrases.explanation: Formal: inversión avanzada, registro periodístico/político.

phrases.text: It would appear that a compromise is unlikely at this stage.
phrases.explanation: Formal: lenguaje distanciado ('it would appear that'), evita afirmaciones directas.

phrases.text: Honestly, I think it's important that everyone vote this year.
phrases.explanation: Informal: subjuntivo simplificado en tono conversacional.

phrases.text: Rarely do people agree on this stuff, it seems!
phrases.explanation: Informal: inversión usada casualmente entre amigos.

phrases.text: It seems like nobody really knows what's going to happen next.
phrases.explanation: Informal: lenguaje distanciado simplificado, tono cotidiano.

phrases.text: I am writing to propose a discussion on the nature of personal identity.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura para invitar a un debate filosófico/académico.

phrases.text: To have never questioned one's beliefs would be, in my view, a missed opportunity.
phrases.explanation: Formal: infinitivo perfecto en registro reflexivo/académico.

phrases.text: I stopped to consider the ethical implications before proceeding.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'stop to do' (detenerse para hacer algo), contraste clásico con 'stop doing'.

phrases.text: I always forget to think about the big questions until late at night, haha.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'forget to do' en tono ligero y humorístico.

phrases.text: I remember reading that book and it totally changed how I think.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'remember doing' (recordar haber hecho), tono personal.

phrases.text: Honestly, I'd hate to have missed this conversation.
phrases.explanation: Informal: infinitivo perfecto casual con contracción.

phrases.text: I am writing to inquire whether the study has been peer-reviewed yet.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pregunta indirecta cortés en contexto académico.

phrases.text: Moreover, the sample size was larger than in previous studies.
phrases.explanation: Formal: conector académico 'moreover' para agregar información.

phrases.text: Our findings did not, however, support the initial hypothesis.
phrases.explanation: Formal: elipsis + 'however' en medio de la oración, estilo académico.

phrases.text: Did your experiment work? Ours didn't, unfortunately.
phrases.explanation: Informal: elipsis casual ('ours didn't'), tono conversacional.

phrases.text: Honestly, neither did I expect these results!
phrases.explanation: Informal: sustitución con 'neither did I', tono espontáneo.

phrases.text: Anyway, we're revising the whole approach now.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'anyway' como marcador de transición casual.

phrases.text: I am writing to formally complain about the inaccurate reporting in your recent article.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura de queja formal a un medio.

phrases.text: It was not until the following day that the error was corrected.
phrases.explanation: Formal: fronting con 'not until', énfasis en el tiempo.

phrases.text: What the article failed to mention was the full context of the event.
phrases.explanation: Formal: oración hendida para señalar una omisión, tono crítico formal.

phrases.text: Not until later did I realize the story was fake news!
phrases.explanation: Informal: fronting casual usado para dramatizar.

phrases.text: What really gets me is how fast fake news spreads.
phrases.explanation: Informal: oración hendida coloquial ('gets me').

phrases.text: Honestly, I don't trust half of what I read online anymore.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario directo y casual sobre medios.

phrases.text: I am writing to inquire whether translations of this document can be arranged.
phrases.explanation: Formal: causativo 'can be arranged' + pregunta indirecta.

phrases.text: It is generally accepted that language influences cultural identity.
phrases.explanation: Formal: pasiva impersonal ('it is generally accepted that'), registro académico.

phrases.text: We had the report translated into three languages for wider accessibility.
phrases.explanation: Formal: causativo 'had + objeto + participio' en contexto institucional.

phrases.text: I got my resume translated before applying abroad.
phrases.explanation: Informal: causativo simple, tono cotidiano.

phrases.text: It's said that learning a language changes how you think, isn't it wild?
phrases.explanation: Informal: pasiva simplificada ('it's said that') en tono casual.

phrases.text: I had my accent 'corrected' in class, but I kind of miss it now.
phrases.explanation: Informal: causativo + reflexión personal, tono relajado.

phrases.text: I am writing to request clarification regarding the new international regulations.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura formal para consultas legales/institucionales.

phrases.text: Provided that all parties comply, the agreement should proceed smoothly.
phrases.explanation: Formal: condicional alternativo 'provided that' en contexto legal.

phrases.text: Notwithstanding the challenges, the treaty represents significant progress.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'notwithstanding' (a pesar de), concesión de registro muy formal/legal.

phrases.text: As long as everyone agrees, I think the plan could work.
phrases.explanation: Informal: condicional alternativo 'as long as' en tono cotidiano.

phrases.text: Even if it's complicated, I still think it's worth trying.
phrases.explanation: Informal: concesión simple con 'even if', tono conversacional.

phrases.text: Unless something changes, we're stuck with the same rules, I guess.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'unless' casual + 'I guess' como matizador.

phrases.text: I am writing to critique the rhetorical strategies employed in your recent speech.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura de análisis retórico formal/académico.

phrases.text: The argument, though persuasive, relies heavily on emotional appeal rather than logic.
phrases.explanation: Formal: concesión + crítica retórica en registro académico.

phrases.text: One might argue that the framing of this issue is deliberately misleading.
phrases.explanation: Formal: hedging ('one might argue') en crítica retórica.

phrases.text: That speech was basically all pathos, barely any facts!
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario crítico casual sobre retórica.

phrases.text: Honestly, the way they framed it felt kind of manipulative.
phrases.explanation: Informal: crítica de framing en tono conversacional.

phrases.text: Ask not what your country can do for you... classic chiasmus, right?
phrases.explanation: Informal: referencia a quiasmo famoso, tono de comentario casual entre entendidos.

phrases.text: I am writing to share my analysis of the novel's narrative structure.
phrases.explanation: Formal: apertura de análisis literario académico.

phrases.text: The unreliable narrator serves to destabilize the reader's trust throughout the text.
phrases.explanation: Formal: análisis literario con vocabulario técnico, registro académico.

phrases.text: The recurring motif of light functions as an allegory for hope.
phrases.explanation: Formal: análisis simbólico en registro literario formal.

phrases.text: I'm not sure I trust the narrator, something feels off.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario personal casual sobre un libro.

phrases.text: That whole subplot was such a good metaphor for grief.
phrases.explanation: Informal: interpretación literaria en tono conversacional.

phrases.text: The ending was so ironic, I did not see that coming!
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual sobre ironía dramática.

phrases.text: I am writing to commend the sharp use of satire in your latest publication.
phrases.explanation: Formal: elogio formal sobre técnica humorística.

phrases.text: The piece employs situational irony to critique contemporary politics.
phrases.explanation: Formal: análisis de humor en registro académico/crítico.

phrases.text: Such understatement, though subtle, proves remarkably effective.
phrases.explanation: Formal: análisis de recurso retórico-humorístico en tono formal.

phrases.text: That was so sarcastic, I couldn't tell if he was joking!
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual sobre sarcasmo.

phrases.text: Honestly, that parody was spot on, so funny.
phrases.explanation: Informal: elogio informal sobre parodia.

phrases.text: His deadpan jokes always get me, haha.
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual sobre humor impasible.

phrases.text: I am writing to request a revision of the document's register for a general audience.
phrases.explanation: Formal: petición profesional sobre estilo/registro.

phrases.text: The excessive use of jargon may hinder comprehension among lay readers.
phrases.explanation: Formal: crítica de estilo con nominalización, registro editorial.

phrases.text: We recommend adopting a more diplomatic tone in future correspondence.
phrases.explanation: Formal: sugerencia profesional sobre registro diplomático.

phrases.text: Honestly, this is way too full of jargon, nobody's gonna get it.
phrases.explanation: Informal: crítica casual sobre lenguaje técnico.

phrases.text: Can you dumb this down a bit? It's super formal right now.
phrases.explanation: Informal: pedido casual de simplificar registro.

phrases.text: That email sounded super corporate, not like you at all!
phrases.explanation: Informal: comentario casual sobre cambio de registro.

phrases.text: I am writing to clarify the intended connotation of the phrase in question.
phrases.explanation: Formal: aclaración sobre matiz de significado, registro editorial.

phrases.text: The figurative language employed here may not translate well across cultures.
phrases.explanation: Formal: análisis de lenguaje figurado, registro académico.

phrases.text: This idiom, though common in speech, would be inappropriate in this formal report.
phrases.explanation: Formal: comentario sobre registro e idiomatismo.

phrases.text: Honestly, I'm still trying to wrap my head around that idiom.
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'wrap my head around' (entender algo), tono coloquial.

phrases.text: That expression really hit the nail on the head!
phrases.explanation: Informal: idiom usado en contexto de conversación casual.

phrases.text: I think I finally got the hang of these phrasal verbs!
phrases.explanation: Informal: 'get the hang of' (agarrarle la mano a algo), tono de logro.

phrases.text: I am writing to submit a concise summary of the report's key findings.
phrases.explanation: Formal: 'précis'/resumen ejecutivo, registro profesional de alto nivel.

phrases.text: Please find below a synthesis of the various perspectives discussed.
phrases.explanation: Formal: síntesis formal de múltiples fuentes, registro académico/profesional.

phrases.text: I would be glad to mediate this discussion for both parties involved.
phrases.explanation: Formal: ofrecimiento de mediación en tono profesional.

phrases.text: Basically, here's the short version of everything we talked about.
phrases.explanation: Informal: parafraseo casual de un resumen ('the short version').

phrases.text: Let me paraphrase that so it makes more sense.
phrases.explanation: Informal: ofrecimiento casual de parafrasear.

phrases.text: I can translate or explain this for you if it's confusing, no worries!
phrases.explanation: Informal: ofrecimiento casual de mediación lingüística.
